snippet.title: Mokomon: Five Elements - Creature Fusion Roguelike Auto Battler (Announcement Teaser)
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5016410/Mokomon_Five_Elements

Build your team, master the Five Elements, and break the game! 
Mokomon: Five Elements is a Roguelike Auto Battler featuring creature taming, non-linear branching evolutions, and tactical asynchronous battles.

KEY FEATURES: 
• Five Elements System (Wu Xing): Water, Fire, Wood, Earth, and Metal synergies.
• Non-Linear Evolution: Fuse and absorb creatures to unlock unique final forms.
• Unique Tamers: Pick your Tamer and adapt your strategy with game-changing passives.
• Relics & Events: High-risk choices and permanent run modifiers.
• Ranked Matches: Battle real player compositions from around the world.

Wishlist today and join our community:
• Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5016410/Mokomon_Five_Elements• Discord: https://discord.gg/rEx2PGZCrc
• Twitter / X: https://x.com/AceHStudios
